reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: Further Announcement – Delay in Submission of the Annual Report for Financial Year 2025/26 Further to its announcements dated 8 October 2026 and 2nd November 2026, Exterminators PLC informs the Colombo Stock Exchange and its shareholders that additional time is required to finalise and submit the Annual Report, including the audited financial statements, for the financial year ended 31 March 2026.
